_meta.do_not_hand_edit: This file is GENERATED ground truth extracted from Stata's own scheme and style files. Regenerate it by re-running scripts/extract_scheme_truth.py; do not hand-edit.
_meta.intensity_multiplier_rule: f<=1: c' = round(255-(255-c)*f); f>1: c' = round(c/f); clamp [0,255]; round half away from zero. Verified empirically against Stata 19.5 SVG export over 24 colour/multiplier cases.
_meta.color_none: Stata colour 'none' is emitted as JSON null.
_meta.sources: Per-scheme 'sources' records, for every extracted property, the exact '<class> <key>' directive that supplied the value after the #include chain and the p#stub->pstub->p#->p fallback were applied. '<class-default>' means the value came from a bare two-token class default line (e.g. 'intensity full'), not from a named key. Notably no Stata base scheme sets 'intensity area', so area_alpha always resolves to the intensity class default.

units.*_size.value: Stata relative size units (sztype gives the kind)
units.*_alpha.pct: percent as written in the scheme; alpha = pct/100
